title: Diosgenin inhibits prostate cancer progression by inducing UHRF1 protein degradation.
authors: Peng, Yuchong; Tang, Rong; Ding, Liuyang; Zheng, Rirong; Liu, Youhong; Yin, Linglong; Fu, Yongming; Deng, Tanggang; Li, Xiong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分薯蓣皂苷通过诱导UHRF1蛋白降解抑制前列腺癌，虽涉及分子对接但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Prostate cancer (PCa) represents the second cause of cancer death in adult men. Aberrant overexpression of UHRF1 has been reported in several cancer types, and is regarded as a novel drug target for cancer therapy. Nevertheless, no UHRF1-targeted small molecule inhibitor has been testing in clinical trials. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) prescriptions have a long history for the treatment of PCa in China, and Chinese herbal extracts are important resources for new drug discovery. In the present study, we first screened the potentially effective components from the commonly used TCMs for PCa treatment in clinic by using network pharmacology together with molecular docking. We identified diosgenin (DSG) as a small molecule natural compound specifically targeting UHRF1 protein. Furthermore, we validated the results by using the wet lab experiments. DSG, by directly binding UHRF1 protein, induced UHRF1 protein degradation through the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway. Importantly, DSG induced UHRF1 protein degradation by reducing the protein interaction with a deubiquitinase USP7. DSG reduced the level of genomic DNA methylation, and elevated the expression of such tumor suppressor genes as p21, p16 and LXN, thereby resulting in cell cycle arrest, cellular senescence and the inhibition of xenograft tumor growth. We here presented the first report that DSG specifically induced UHRF1 protein degradation, thereby revealing a novel anticancer mechanism of DSG. Altogether, this present study provided a promising strategy to discover new molecule-targeted drugs from small-molecule natural products.
abstract_zh: 前列腺癌（PCa）是成年男性癌症死亡的第二大原因。UHRF1的异常过表达已在多种癌症类型中被报道，并被视为癌症治疗的新型药物靶点。然而，目前尚无针对UHRF1的小分子抑制剂进入临床试验阶段。中药（TCM）处方在中国治疗前列腺癌方面有着悠久的历史，中草药提取物是新药发现的重要资源。在本研究中，我们首先利用网络药理学结合分子对接技术，从临床常用于治疗前列腺癌的中药中筛选出潜在有效成分。我们鉴定出薯蓣皂苷元（DSG）作为一种特异性靶向UHRF1蛋白的小分子天然化合物。此外，我们通过湿实验验证了这些结果。DSG通过直接结合UHRF1蛋白，经由泛素-蛋白酶体途径诱导UHRF1蛋白降解。重要的是，DSG通过减少UHRF1与去泛素化酶USP7的蛋白相互作用来诱导UHRF1蛋白降解。DSG降低了基因组DNA甲基化水平，并上调了如p21、p16和LXN等肿瘤抑制基因的表达，从而导致细胞周期阻滞、细胞衰老以及异种移植肿瘤生长的抑制。我们在此首次报道DSG特异性诱导UHRF1蛋白降解，从而揭示了DSG的一种新型抗癌机制。总之，本研究为从小分子天然产物中发现新的分子靶向药物提供了一种有前景的策略。
